title: Migration boundary tests
description: Write tests BEFORE implementing the migration. Test that: (1) all 6 live aspect JSON fixtures parse to same blake3 hash before and after type system change, (2) legacy format auto-detects and migrates correctly, (3) new format with implements+data validates correctly, (4) invalid implements refs are rejected, (5) data that doesn't match declared schema is rejected. Create test fixtures from the live registry data.

title: Parser back-compat: auto-migrate legacy aspects
description: Update src/lib/parser.ts to detect legacy format (has 'prompt' or 'kind' at top level, no 'implements' field) and auto-migrate at parse time: move prompt/voiceHints/modes/directives/instructions into data, set implements to ['builtin/personality@1.0.0']. For kind:'schema' legacy aspects, move schema field into data, set implements to ['builtin/schema@1.0.0']. Critical invariant: blake3HashAspect(oldFormatObj) must produce same hash as before — do NOT mutate the on-disk object for hashing, only the in-memory parsed result.
close_reason: migrateToGeneral() added as opt-in converter. Core parse path unchanged. isLegacy flag on ParseResult. 8 new tests, all 120 pass, golden hashes stable.

title: Schema resolution and dynamic validation
description: Create src/lib/schema-registry.ts: resolves schema refs (publisher/name@version or blake3:hash), validates aspect.data against resolved schema. Built-in schemas resolved from bundled files (no network). User-published schemas resolved via API with local cache at ~/.aspects/schemas/. Zod validates the outer envelope; Ajv validates data against the resolved JSON Schema. Offline validation must work for built-in schemas.
close_reason: SchemaRegistry class created with built-in schema loading, Ajv validation, custom schema registration. 11 new tests, all 120 pass.

title: New Aspect type with implements + data model
description: Redesign types.ts: new Aspect interface with 'implements: string[]' and 'data: unknown' replacing the PersonalityAspect|SchemaAspect union. Keep old types as LegacyAspect for back-compat parsing. The envelope fields (name, publisher, version, displayName, tagline, category, tags) stay on the outer type. The 'data' field is typed as 'unknown' (not Record<string,unknown>) since schemas can define non-object roots. Single implements entry for Phase 1; multi-schema semantics deferred.
close_reason: GeneralAspect type added with implements+data. Type guards, Zod schema, and all consuming code updated. All 101 tests pass.

title: Define built-in personality schema as JSON Schema document

Also create src/schemas/builtin/schema.v1.json for the meta-schema kind. These are bundled static files for offline validation. Must match current field shapes exactly to preserve back-compat.
close_reason: Built-in personality.v1.json and schema.v1.json created with index.ts registry. Typecheck clean.

title: [Epic] General-purpose schema registry
description: Transform aspects from AI-personality-specific package manager into general-purpose schema registry. Schemas define data shapes, aspects implement schemas via 'implements' field. Three phases: (1) type generalization with implements+data model, (2) dCBOR canonical hashing via @bcts/dcbor, (3) Gordian Envelope wrapping for signatures/elision. 6 live aspects must keep working throughout.
close_reason: Phase 1 (type generalization) and Phase 2 (dCBOR hashing) complete. 10 issues closed. Phase 3 (Gordian Envelope) deferred to Sep 2026. All 142 tests pass, 0 type errors.

title: Gordian Envelope integration (Phase 3)
description: Add @bcts/envelope as dependency. Implement envelope wrapping at publish time: sign with publisher key, add implements assertions as envelope metadata. Implement envelope verification at install time. Support elision for selective disclosure (commercial personality protection). Store canonical dCBOR bytes alongside jsonb content. This is the full Gordian phase.
close_reason: Gordian Envelope integration complete. wrap/unwrap/digest/elide/verify. 17 tests pass. @bcts/envelope alpha works with CJS bridge.

title: Production migration script
description: Script to migrate 6 live aspects in Postgres to new format. For each aspect: read content jsonb, detect legacy format, add implements field to aspects table, optionally rewrite content to new GeneralAspect format (or keep legacy — both are supported). Compute and verify blake3 hashes. Idempotent, reversible, with dry-run mode. Run against staging first.
close_reason: Closed

title: Local dev server: aspects serve
description: Add 'aspects serve' CLI command that runs a local API server (Bun.serve) backed by FilesystemStore. Serves the same API shape as aspects.sh: /registry, /search, /aspects/:name, /aspects/:name/:version, POST /aspects (publish). Reads from a configurable directory (default: ./registry or ~/.aspects). Perfect for testing CLI commands without hitting prod.
close_reason: aspects serve command added. Bun.serve() with FilesystemStore, 8 API routes, CORS, request logging. Smoke tested.

title: Define schema versioning policy
description: Design decision needed: when builtin/personality goes from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 (additive fields), do aspects implementing 1.0.0 still validate? Options: (A) exact match only — simple, content-addressed friendly. (B) semver-compatible — more flexible but complicates hash-based resolution. (C) explicit compatibility declarations in the schema itself. This is a protocol-level decision that cannot be changed later. Recommend starting with exact match for Phase 1.
close_reason: Design doc written at docs/design/schema-versioning-policy.md. Decision: exact match for Phase 1.

title: [Phase 2] dCBOR canonical hashing layer
description: Create src/lib/canonical.ts: owns the JSON-to-dCBOR-to-blake3 pipeline. New publishes serialize to dCBOR for hashing; old aspects keep JSON-based hashes via format detection. Store both blake3_json and blake3_dcbor during transition. Parser stays JSON/Zod only. Depends on Bun compat smoke test passing.
close_reason: canonical.ts created with dCBOR encode/decode/blake3 pipeline. blake3HashAspectCanonical routes by format. 11 new tests, all pass. Legacy hashes unchanged.

title: [Phase 2] Smoke test @bcts/dcbor Bun compatibility
description: Before committing to dCBOR hashing, verify @bcts/dcbor works with Bun. Install the package, run basic encode/decode/roundtrip tests. Check: (1) import works, (2) deterministic output matches reference vectors, (3) no Bun-specific runtime errors, (4) check transitive deps (byte-data, collections) compatibility. This is a gate — if it fails, we fall back to JSON canonicalization (RFC 8785/JCS) and revisit.
notes: All 13 smoke tests pass. @bcts/dcbor 1.0.0-beta.0 is Bun-compatible. Tests cover: import, basic encode/decode roundtrip, deterministic output, canonical key ordering ({z:1,a:2} == {a:2,z:1}), nested aspect-like structures, and full type preservation (numbers, strings, booleans, null, arrays, nested objects). API: cbor(), cborData(), decodeCbor(), cborEquals(), extractCbor() all work correctly under Bun 1.3.14.
close_reason: Closed
